subject: Duplicate charge on invoice #INV-98241
body: Hi Team, I noticed that my credit card was charged twice ($499.00) for our monthly subscription on September 15th. Could you please check this transaction and process a refund for the duplicate charge as soon as possible?

subject: Urgent: App crashing on login after latest iOS update
body: Hello Support, several of our team members are experiencing immediate app crashes right after entering credentials on iOS 18.2. Is there a patch available or a workaround we can apply?

subject: Enterprise Plan pricing and custom SLA inquiry for 500 seats
body: Good morning, we are evaluating your platform for our enterprise rollout across 500 team members. We would like to schedule a demo and request a customized quote including 99.99% SLA terms.

subject: Application for Senior Backend Engineer position
body: Dear HR Manager, I am submitting my resume and cover letter for the Senior Backend Engineer position listed on your careers portal. I have 7 years of experience building high-concurrency Microservices in Go and Python.

subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II audit report & GDPR DPA
body: Hello Compliance Team, before completing our security vendor review, our InfoSec department requires a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report and signed Data Processing Addendum.

subject: Tax exemption certificate submission for annual bill
body: Please find attached our state tax exemption certificate for account #AC-7712. Kindly update our billing profile so sales tax is excluded from our upcoming annual renewal invoice.

subject: API 500 Internal Server Error on /v1/webhooks endpoint
body: Our integration is receiving HTTP 500 errors when posting events to your webhook endpoint. Stack trace indicates database connection pool exhaustion on your server side.

subject: Inquiry regarding reseller partnership and wholesale pricing
body: We operate a regional MSP in Europe and would like to discuss reselling your cloud platform to our client network. Are there reseller tier discounts available?

subject: Verification of employment request for Jane Doe
body: This is a formal employment verification request from First National Bank regarding your employee Jane Doe. Please confirm job title and start date using the attached form.

subject: Report of potential suspicious login activity on admin user
body: Our SIEM triggered an alert showing multiple failed SSH login attempts on host ip-10-0-4-12 coming from an unapproved IP range. Please investigate if this server is compromised.

subject: Need wire transfer instructions for invoice payment
body: Can you provide ACH / IBAN wire transfer details for paying our outstanding invoice #8812? Our accounting department requires this for vendor setup.

subject: SSL certificate expired on custom domain endpoint
body: Visitors to our custom domain sub.ourdomain.com are getting browser privacy warnings because the automatic SSL certificate renewal failed last night.

subject: RFP submission request for government procurement project
body: Our department is issuing an RFP for cloud collaboration tools. We would invite your sales team to submit a response by October 15th.

subject: Inquiry about remote work policy and health benefits package
body: Hi HR team, I am reviewing our onboarding materials and had a quick question regarding health insurance coverage start dates and dental tier options.

subject: Vulnerability Disclosure: Reflected XSS in search parameter
body: Security Alert: During security testing I discovered a reflected XSS vulnerability in the query string parameter 'q' on your search results page. Details attached.

subject: Credit card expired - update payment method request
body: Our corporate credit card expired end of last month. Please send us the secure link to update our card details so our account isn't suspended.

subject: Latency spikes over 3000ms on database read queries
body: We are observing severe query latency spikes on our production database cluster during peak hours between 2pm and 4pm UTC. Requesting database admin assistance.

subject: Can we upgrade from Pro to Business plan mid-cycle?
body: We want to upgrade our team from Pro to Business immediately to unlock advanced SSO. Will the cost be prorated for the remainder of this month?

subject: Status of interview feedback for Product Manager role
body: Hi Recruiting, I completed my final round interview for the Senior Product Manager position last Thursday and wanted to check in on next steps in the process.

subject: User account lockout reset for 2FA token replacement
body: Our user lost their hardware 2FA key security token and is locked out of their account. Requesting administrator identity verification and 2FA bypass reset.

subject: Requesting refund for unused seats after team downsizing
body: We reduced our team size by 15 users last week. We would like to downgrade our seat count and receive a refund for the prepaid unused monthly balance.

subject: Python SDK throwing ModuleNotFoundError on import
body: When running `import platform_sdk` under Python 3.11, the interpreter throws an ImportError for missing sub-module `auth_utils`. Code snippet attached.

subject: Requesting product demo for C-suite executive team
body: Our VP of Engineering and CTO would like a live 30-minute product demonstration focused on enterprise security integrations and scalability.

subject: 401k retirement plan contribution change request
body: Hello HR, I would like to increase my bi-weekly 401k payroll deduction percentage from 5% to 8% starting next pay period.

subject: GDPR Right to be Forgotten data deletion request
body: Under GDPR Article 17, I formally request the permanent deletion of all personal data associated with user email account user@domain.com.

subject: Incorrect currency applied on international invoice
body: Our invoice #UK-9021 was issued in USD ($1,200) instead of GBP (£1,200) as specified in our contract agreement. Please re-issue invoice in GBP.

subject: Docker container failing healthcheck on deployment
body: Our Kubernetes deployment pod is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff state because the container health check endpoint `/healthz` returns timeout.

subject: Inquiry on volume discount for non-profit organizations
body: We are a registered 501(c)(3) educational non-profit organisation. Do you offer special non-profit pricing tiers or non-profit grant licenses?

subject: Maternity leave policy guidelines request
body: Hi People Ops, could you share the detailed document regarding parental and maternity leave benefits and paid time off policies?

subject: Penetration test authorization and IP whitelisting
body: Our third-party security auditor is scheduling a pen test for next Monday. We need authorization and IP whitelisting for tester subnet 198.51.100.0/24.

subject: Disputing unauthorized add-on charge on monthly statement
body: There is a $99 line item on our September bill for 'Advanced Analytics Addon' which we never authorized or enabled. Please issue a credit note.

subject: WebSocket connection dropping every 60 seconds
body: Our real-time event listener drops WebSocket connections continuously every 60 seconds with close code 1006. Proxy ping timeout suspected.

subject: Contract renewal terms for upcoming fiscal year
body: Our annual subscription expires in 60 days. We would like to discuss renewal pricing, multi-year lock-in discounts, and payment terms.

subject: Submission of expense reimbursement receipt for travel
body: Attached are my flight and hotel receipts for the tech conference last week totaling $840. Please submit for manager approval and payroll reimbursement.

subject: Mandatory password reset enforcement policy question
body: Does your platform support enforcing mandatory 90-day password rotation and preventing password reuse for team members via SAML SSO?

subject: Receipt request for tax filing year 2025
body: Could you provide a consolidated PDF receipt of all payments made on our account during the 2025 calendar year for tax accounting?

subject: Memory leak detected in node background worker process
body: The background worker process node memory usage increases by 100MB per hour until OOM killer terminates the pod. Memory snapshot attached.

subject: Request for pilot trial account extension
body: Our 14-day evaluation trial ends tomorrow. We need an extension of 14 additional days so our executive committee can complete testing.

subject: Internal referral bonus claim submission
body: I referred candidate Mark Smith who was successfully hired for the DevOps position last month. Please confirm when the referral bonus will be paid out.

subject: ISO 27001 compliance certificate request
body: Our enterprise risk management committee requires proof of your ISO 27001 certification and vendor security risk questionnaire responses.

subject: Payment gateway processing error 402 - insufficient funds
body: Our automatic renewal payment failed this morning with error code 402. We have replenished funds and would like to retry the transaction manually.

subject: GraphQL query returning NULL for nested user fields
body: When querying the GraphQL endpoint `user { profile { phone } }`, the query returns null even when data exists in database. Schema bug suspected.

subject: Custom feature development request for enterprise contract
body: We are ready to sign a 3-year contract if custom export capability to S3 buckets can be built into our dedicated instance.

subject: Request for updated W-4 tax withholding form
body: Hello Payroll, I need to update my W-4 tax withholding allowances following a change in family status. Please send the digital update link.

subject: Notification of phishing email targeting company domain
body: Warning: Several employees received spoofed emails pretending to be from HR requesting credential logins. Domain block requested for scamdomain.com.

subject: Overdue balance notice clarification
body: We received an automated email stating our account has an overdue balance of $150, but our records show payment was cleared on Sept 10. Receipt attached.

subject: OAuth2 refresh token expiring prematurely after 1 hour
body: OAuth refresh tokens issued by `/oauth/token` are expiring after 60 minutes instead of the configured 30 days. Grant type authorization_code.

subject: Competitive switch offer inquiry from competitor product
body: We are currently using Product X but experiencing downtime. What incentives or migration support do you offer for switching companies?

subject: Inquiry regarding tuition reimbursement program
body: Hi HR, does the company offer financial tuition reimbursement for master's degree courses relevant to software engineering?

subject: Emergency API key revocation due to public git commit
body: Security Incident: An engineer accidentally committed a production API secret key to a public GitHub repository. Please immediately revoke key `sk_live_99281`.
